units: Package describes Layer 3 as authority redistribution after MRAT attribution.
Package exports AdaptiveInheritanceEngine, MechanismWeight, and AuthorityState.
Implementation distinguishes confidence revision from authority revision and states AIC/ARR/authority-half-life intent.
MechanismWeight stores name, operational weight, and admissibility.
AuthorityState stores weight dictionary and sums total authority.
Engine initializes one MechanismWeight per supplied weight, a default learning rate, and confidence 1.0 per mechanism.
Engine exposes get_weight, get_weights, and set_weight without normalization of the global distribution.
apply_feedback updates one weight using current*(1-learning_rate*(1-admissibility)), clamps only the lower bound at zero, and stores admissibility.
update_confidence independently adjusts and clamps confidence to [0,1]; it does not change authority.
ARR helper returns current/previous weight and returns zero for previous weight zero.
Half-life helper repeatedly mutates the mechanism via apply_feedback until threshold crossing or max steps.
export_state returns current mechanism weights as AuthorityState.
admissibility and learning_rate are not validated to [0,1], so the implementation can accept values outside the formal metric assumptions.
Weights are not normalized as a probability/simplex distribution; their interpretation as a future mechanism distribution remains source-underspecified.
Package describes MRAT as routing empirical residuals to the lowest-cost structural explanation.
Package exports MRATRouter, AttributionVector, and FailureLayer.
FailureLayer enum orders Noise, State, Mechanism, Representation, Generator.
AttributionVector stores five continuous masses, can expose a dict, validate simplex constraints, and choose argmax layer.
Router has residual thresholds 0.1, 0.8, and 0.9 by default.
route accepts a scalar residual plus optional full supplied scores; if all scores are provided it validates and returns them.
Residual <= noise threshold maps entirely to Noise.
Residual below representation threshold maps to fixed 0.1/0.2/0.7 Noise/State/Mechanism vector.
Residual between representation and generator thresholds maps fixed 0.05/0.05/0.1/0.8/0 vector.
Residual at or above generator threshold maps fixed 0.02/0.03/0.05/0.2/0.7 vector.
route_intervention validates attribution then selects dominant layer.
adaptive_cost_level maps N/S/M/R/G to integer levels 0/1/2/3/4.
Default attribution is a hand-coded residual-threshold baseline; the source provides no empirical identification showing these outputs correspond to true failure loci.
Partial externally supplied scores are ignored unless all five are non-null; semantics for partial evidence are unspecified.
